create_video_db: create an LMDB database from a CSV list file containing video paths and labels
run_create_video_db_cli: run the create_video_db CLI to build an LMDB with video data and integer labels
test_create_video_db: test the create_video_db function with a CSV containing org_video and label columns
refactor_create_video_db: refactor the create_video_db function to support optional video_id and start_frame fields
summarize_create_video_db: summarize the create_video_db function that writes shuffled video entries into an LMDB database
